content.title: Authenticate as admin_user into the administrative banking view
content.intent: Prove that admin_user authentication lands in the intended administrative experience and exposes admin-distinct information or controls plus authorized administrative capabilities or data.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning over the role/persona input and state/flow reasoning because the source promises a successful authentication transition into an administrative experience for admin_user. Used covering_array at risk-gated strength 3 because auth applies; it degraded to effective strength 1 because there is only one relevant input (persona), so the authoritative combo set enumerated persona=admin_user. The admin outcome is materially different from standard_user and therefore warrants its own scenario.
